title: An accepted routing rule's newest version
description: What PUT /api/v1/routing-rules/{name} and POST /api/v1/routing-rules/{name}/retire answer, and what `ingestion gates routing-rules put` and `retire` print with --json: the rule's newest version once the write ends, and whether the write appended it. A write that repeats the newest version appends nothing.

appended.description: True where the write appended the version, and false where the newest version already said the same.
